card.name: Separators inside drug name lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'or', arrows and parentheses right after a drug name in a list of drugs, especially anticoagulants and kinase inhibitors. Also the opening bracket after a brand name before the generic name.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma, 'or' or arrow just after one drug in a run of similar drugs.
modes.example: ixaban<< or>> rivaroxaban and had elevated baseline

modes.label: Brand name bracket
modes.description: The open parenthesis after a capitalized brand name, where the generic name follows.
modes.example: the drug being prepared and administered is HERCESSI TM<< (>>trastuzumab-strf)

modes.label: Inside anticoagulant names
modes.description: Partway through or at the end of a name such as dabigatran or SAVAYSA.
modes.example: Direct Oral Anticoagulants (DOACs) rivaroxaban dabigat<<ran>> edoxaban ↑ DOAC Refer to

card.writes: It promotes 'generic' and suppresses 'patent' and brand-related tokens, so it favors a generic drug name next.
card.plain: It marks the spot right after a drug name where another drug name or a generic name is about to come.
